metadata.title: Five affine steps with joint returned-source counting · 0.8748087
metadata.description: Proves all-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing for Re(s) > 8748087/10000000 = 0.8748087, excluding the principal pole. The finite-depth affine argument retains residual reduction and reciprocal source weights, follows LOW continuations through five affine stages, and counts returned HIGH histories jointly with one final density payment. Both the detector and weighted numerator use an actual uniformly constructed root moment; the finite backward induction, all-height split, source thresholds and canonical endpoint are supplied as Lean proofs. Builds on ArviFoxy’s two-level affine source construction, Zhongpai Gao’s balanced marked ledger, Hailey Collet’s affine moment and quartic framework, Akash Levy’s weighted numerator, and the OpenAI baseline; inherited contributions and license notices are retained. Developed with AI assistance.

pr.title: Improve the all-Dirichlet boundary to 0.8748087
pr.body:
QRH-Result: gao-five-step-affine-20261020
QRH-Bound: 8748087/10000000
QRH-Decimal: 0.8748087

Proves all-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing for `Re(s) > 0.8748087`, excluding the principal pole.

Five finite affine stages retain the LOW source, its residual reduction and reciprocal weights. Returned HIGH histories are counted jointly with one final density payment. The proof constructs the uniform root moment used by both the detector and weighted numerator, then closes the canonical `Candidate.bound` without additional analytic assumptions.

[Four-page paper](https://github.com/Gaozhongpai/QuasiRiemannTracker/blob/5085baa8fd0814c60f3ae523c6d1ce697bf12752/submissions/gao-five-step-affine-20261020/paper/paper.pdf) · [Canonical Lean theorem](https://github.com/Gaozhongpai/QuasiRiemannTracker/blob/f07bb2418990a9976c0da5f65bb6a7a77da94c9a/submissions/gao-five-step-affine-20261020/src/Candidate/Main.lean) · [Publication metadata](https://github.com/Gaozhongpai/QuasiRiemannTracker/blob/f07bb2418990a9976c0da5f65bb6a7a77da94c9a/submissions/gao-five-step-affine-20261020/metadata.json)

Validation: the exact canonical theorem and submitted entry point pass necessary local Lean checks with only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. The official metadata/dependency validator passes. Full replay and independent-kernel admission are left to the repository workflow.

Builds on ArviFoxy’s two-level affine construction (#67), Gao’s balanced marked ledger (#63), Collet’s affine framework, Levy’s weighted numerator and OpenAI’s baseline. Reached PR67 `Candidate` modules are included unchanged because they are not exposed as reusable `Submissions` modules; original notices are retained. Developed with AI assistance.

The source-only admission directory contains exactly `metadata.json` and Lean modules. The paper is linked from an immutable commit on the preserved paper branch.
